div.head: Abt 65.1
div.ab: Gif he healt weorð, þær motan freond seman.
Gif he healt weorð, þær motan freond seman.
If he becomes lame, then friends must arbitrate.
If he becomes lame, the settlement of the matter may be left to friends.
Wenn er [der Verwundete] lahm wird: da müssen Freunde [schiedsrichterlich] schlichten.
If he [the wounded man] becomes lame: then friends must settle it [as arbitrators].

note.seg: Bei Lähmung (s. d. Gl) verzichtet der Staat auch sonst auf Festsetzung der Busssumme
Elsewhere too, in cases of lameness (see that word in Gl), the state refrains from fixing the amount of compensation
correct to: ‘the kindreds may’, that is, those of both parties.
Das Schiedsgericht (s. d. Gl 2. 5a. b) trat nur ein, wo das Gesetz es erlaubte; Heusler Institut. I 51
Arbitration (see that word in Gl 2. 5a. b) applied only where the law permitted it; Heusler Institut. I 51
